newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CEZ to begin U.S. debt roadshow soon-CTK.
newsitem.headline: CEZ to begin U.S. debt roadshow soon-CTK.

text.p: The main Czech power generator CEZ a.s. is expected begin a roadshow to promote its planned debt offering of at least $200 million later this month, the Czech CTK agency reported on Thursday.
It quoted a CEZ spokesman as saying chief financial officer Gabriel Eichler was expected to begin making presentations mostly to U.S. investors on July 11.
CEZ's Dutch-registered financial arm, CEZ Finance B.V., filed on Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register the offering of guaranteed notes due 2007.

Underwriters for the offering are J.P. Morgan & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co and Salomon Brothers Inc. Proceeds from the sale will be used for capital expenditures, to refinance short-term borrowings and for other general corporate needs.
